stop.question: Task #108 (meeting handles + «Поделиться встречей») builds on the meeting range itself, which has not landed and has no active change. The task assumes a meeting can already be chosen by tap/drag and that the meeting frame, cell dimming, local ranges in rows and the meeting bar with «Сбросить выбор встречи» exist (items 01, 04, 09: 'После выбора встречи…', 'рядом с «Сбросить выбор встречи»'). In the base (111ad7f): (1) `grep -r 'MeetingRange|MEETING_RANGE|meetingRange' packages/client/src` finds nothing — no model, command, frame or bar; (2) openspec/changes/archive/2026/11/2026-11-09-add-grid-hour-cells-and-hour-frame/proposal.md:9 says 'The meeting range (ADR-0011) is the next change and builds on these cells' and :51 NG1 defers tap/drag, meeting frame, meeting bar and Clear meeting to it; (3) docs/glossary/time-selection.md still marks Meeting range, Meeting frame and Meeting bar *(planned)*; docs/architecture/views.md Catalog says Grid 'meeting follows'; (4) openspec/changes/ holds only add-pr-preview-deploy, unrelated. So the change this task needs first (SET_MEETING_RANGE / CLEAR_MEETING_RANGE in the model, tap and drag on hour cells, meeting frame, dimming, local ranges, meeting bar with Clear) is neither on main nor planned as an active change. How should this task proceed?
options: Wait: park #108 until the meeting range change (tap/drag selection, frame, meeting bar, Clear) lands on main, then rerun
Widen #108: specify the whole meeting range from ADR-0011 (model commands, tap/drag, frame, dimming, meeting bar, Clear) together with handles and Share in one change
Other: name the change or branch that brings the meeting range and declare #108 as building on it
